name: Data Engineer Pack
description: Workflows for coding agents building data pipelines, ETL systems, and streaming architectures: pipeline design, data quality, schema management, and orchestration.
useCases: Design an ETL or streaming pipeline with explicit data-quality checks, schema contracts, and orchestration.
Evolve a warehouse or event schema safely without breaking downstream consumers.
Add observability to an existing pipeline and debug failed or late-arriving data runs.
examplePrompts: Design an ingestion pipeline for this event stream, including schema management, data-quality checks, and backfill strategy.
This dbt/Airflow job produced inconsistent output — trace the root cause and propose tests that catch it.
